capabilities.description: Write the issue at /jira/<site>/<key> with its title, read once through acli, unless a record is already there.

key.description: The issue key, such as ACME-123.
key.title: Key

site.description: The site name before .atlassian.net, such as acme; the config record's site when left out.
site.title: Site

capabilities.name: ref

outputSchema.description:
The issue's record, whether this call wrote it, and why it has no title when it has none.

`title_note` is null when the record has a title or was already there.
outputSchema.title: RefOutput

description: Record a Jira issue as a typed jira/issue/v1 record that other records can reference. Use it when work names a Jira ticket. Start with `board -C <board> call jira.ref --key ACME-123 --site acme`, which writes /jira/acme/ACME-123 once with its title. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: jira
